chapter.verse: Tua ciangin dawimangpa' siatzolna a thuak dingin Kha in gamgawtak ah Jesu paipih hi.
Sun sawmli leh zan sawmli antan khit ciangin Jesu gilkial hi.
Siatzolpa hong pai-in, “Nang Pasian' Tapa na hih takpi leh hih suangtumte anlum a suah nadingun thupia in,” ci hi.
Ahi zongin Jesu in hih bangin dawngkik hi: “Hih bangin kigelh hi, “‘Mihing pen anlum bek tawh hilo, Pasian' kam pana hong pusuak thu khempeuh tawh nungta ding hi.’”
Tua ciangin dawimangpa in khuapi siangtho ah amah paipihin biakinnpi khumdawn ah dingsak a,

hih bangin ci hi: “Nang Pasian' Tapa na hihleh diangsuk in. A hang pen hih bangin a kigelh om hi, “‘Amah in nang' vai-in a vanmite thupia ding hi,’ cih leh, “‘Suangtum tungah na khe na tahkhak loh nadingin a khut uh tawh nang hong dom ding uh hi.’ ”
Jesu in, “Tu-a vai ah zong, ‘Topa na Pasian na zia-et kei ding hi,’ ci-in kigelh hi,” ci-in dawng hi.
Dawimangpa in mual a sang mahmah khat ah paipih leuleu a, leitung kumpigam khempeuh leh tuate' vangliat thupitna teng lak hi.
Tua ciangin Jesu' kiangah, “Boksukin kei nong biak leh hihte a vekin nang kong pia ding hi,” ci hi.
Jesu in hih bangin dawng hi: “Satan, paikhia in! A hang pen hih bangin kigelh hi: “‘Topa na Pasian na bia ding a, ama' na bek na sem ding hi.’”
Tua ciangin dawimangpa in Jesu paikhiatsan a, en un, vanmite hong pai-in Jesu don uh hi.
Tu-in Jesu in John kiman cih thu a zak ciangin Galilee gam sungah kihem hi.
Nazareth khua nusia-in Zebulun leh Naphtali uk sung, tuili gei Capernaum khua ah teeng hi.
Tua pen a nuai-a kamsang Isaiah' thugen a tangtun nading ahi hi:
“Zebulun gam leh Naphtali gam, Jordan gungal, tuili gei-a lampi, Gentile mite' tenna Galilee-
khuamial sunga om mite khuavak lianpi mu khin uh a, sihna gam leh liim nuai-a om mite tungah khuavak taang khinta hi.”
Tua hun-a kipan Jesu thutangko kipan a, “Kisik un. A hang pen vantung kumpigam hong tung kuanta hi,” ci hi.
Galilee Tuili gei-ah Jesu lam a pai laitak, tuili sunga ngen a khuh Simon (Peter zong a kici) leh a sanggampa Andrew, unau nihte mu hi. (Amau pen ngabengte ahi uh hi.)
Jesu in amaute' kiangah, “Hong zui un. Mi a mante kong suaksak ding hi,” ci hi.
Amau zong thakhat thu-in a ngente uh nusia-in Jesu zui pah uh hi.
Tua pan a paisuak ciangin Jesu in unau dang nih ahi Zebedee' tapa James leh a sanggampa John, gunkuang sungah a pa uh Zebedee tawh ngen phopin om a muh ciangin sam hi.
Amau zong thakhat thu-in gunkuang leh a pa uh nusia-in Jesu zui pah uh hi.
Tua ciangin Galilee gam sung citeng ah Jesu pai kawikawi-in amaute' vengkhawm innte ah thu hilhcian a, kumpigam Lungdamna Thu tangko-in mite' natna leh zawngkhalna namkim damsak hi.

Tua hangin Syria gam sung teng ah a minthanna kizel hi. Mite in zong cina a kici khempeuh, natlesat namkim a thuak mite, dawilut mite, sibup kongkaw theite leh pumzaw mite ama' kiangah paipih uh a, amah in tuate damsak hi.
Tua ciangin Galilee leh Decapolis pan ahi zongin, Jerusalem leh Judea pan ahi zongin, Jordan gungalkhat pan ahi zongin mihonpite in amah zui uh hi.
